pr_title: Use ssize_t and off_t definitions from sys/types.h
pr_body:
The PR contains two commits:
 - removing fs.h local definitions of off_t ans ssize_t,, and using sys/types.h instead;
 - fixing littlefs sample printk formatting.

Fixes: #37665

issue_context.title: File system: wrong type for ssize_t in fs.h for CONFIG_ARCH_POSIX
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
In fs.h ssize_t is defined as __SIZE_TYPE__, which is a unsigned type. ssize_t should be signed.

**To Reproduce**
Run/compile this code snipped, the printf statement will not be executed. 
#include "fs/fs.h"
..
ssize_t i = -10;
    if (i < 0) {
        printf("test ok");
    }


**Expected behavior**
printf will be executed.

**Impact**
Project unit tests on Linux are failing. 

**Logs and console output**


**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Linux
 - Toolchain: Zephyr SDK



**Additional context**
Proposal:
`
diff --git a/include/fs/fs.h b/include/fs/fs.h
index 76bf25bd10..6da866d58b 100644
--- a/include/fs/fs.h
+++ b/include/fs/fs.h
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@
 
 #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_POSIX
 #ifndef __ssize_t_defined
-typedef __SIZE_TYPE__ ssize_t;
+typedef __SWORD_TYPE ssize_t;
 #define __ssize_t_defined
 #endif
`
